text: I was hurt in a car accident in Newcastle. Which compensation lawyers should I contact?

sections.text:

### 1. **Slater and Gordon**
Their expert team of motor vehicle and car accident lawyers have decades of combined experience in handling all types of transport and motor vehicle accident claims.
They handle personal injury, motor vehicle accidents, workers' compensation, and more, and their personal injury lawyers will do all they can to get the compensation and entitlements you deserve.

🌐 [slatergordon.com.au](https://www.slatergordon.com.au/offices/newcastle)

---

### Important Tips:
-
It is never too early to contact a lawyer — speaking to one soon after your injury means evidence is preserved and deadlines are met.
Court proceedings must usually start within 3 years, though that limit can be extended in some circumstances.

- Most of the above firms offer **free initial consultations** and **No Win, No Fee** arrangements.

I hope you recover quickly and get the compensation you deserve!
